name: VHS Tracking
description: Tape-tracking bands of white snow roll down the frame, tearing the lines around them, with smeared color, wobbling lines, a jittering strip at the bottom and a dropout flash, as the second clip is recorded over the first under the densest band. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: bands
params.description: Number of noise bands rolling down (the first one carries the cut)

params.name: noise
params.description: Amount of snow and tearing in the bands

params.name: bleed
params.description: How far the color smears to the right of the picture

params.name: wobble
params.description: How much the lines wobble sideways
